description:
A calmer desktop. Everything within reach.

Give every project a place. PecoFence organizes your Windows 11 desktop into fences: glass panels that keep your files close and give your wallpaper room to breathe.

LET YOUR AI SET IT UP
PecoFence includes pecofence-cli. Tell a coding agent such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor what you want in your own words: it reads your current setup and applies the changes, from new fences and sorting rules to icon sizes, colors and themes. Snapshots and configuration export keep a copy of a setup you like.

LESS TIME SORTING
Set rules for file types, names, age or size. New desktop files appear in the right fence automatically. Automatic sorting leaves their locations on disk unchanged.

YOUR FILES, ONE SHORTCUT AWAY
Press Ctrl + Alt + Space to bring your fences above the current app. Grab what you need, then press Esc to return.

A SPACE FOR EVERY PROJECT
Combine related fences into tabs. Switch in a click, or drag a tab out into its own fence. Keep a live folder on the desktop and browse its subfolders in place.

MAKE ROOM FOR FOCUS
Double-click empty desktop space to hide your fences and again to bring them back. Roll a fence up to its title bar and hover to expand it.

GLASS THAT FITS YOUR DESKTOP
Choose Fluent or Liquid Glass, light or dark, then adjust each fence's color and opacity. Save your layout with snapshots and backups.

LIGHT ON YOUR PC
PecoFence is a native application that idles at about 40 MB of memory in Task Manager. The settings window loads only when you open it.

Free and open source under Apache 2.0. No app account required. Ten built-in display languages, available offline. Designed for Windows 10 22H2 / Windows 11 x64.

PecoFence uses real files: file operations you initiate, including moves, renames and deletions, affect files on disk. Your normal Windows desktop icons return when the app exits.

releaseNotes: What's new: the fence menu and the tray menu show icons beside their commands, and a locked fence's menu offers Unlock position and size. Clicking the tray icon opens Settings; right-click it for the menu. Feedback is now part of About in Settings, and the configuration file moved to Layout and backups › Backups. After a week of use, PecoFence asks once whether you'd like to rate it. Fixes: Open configuration folder opens the right folder, renaming an icon that needs administrator rights asks for permission the way File Explorer does, and Open file location selects icons whose names contain a space.
